title: Scaling the Relief on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Fee by How Long the Circle Membership Has Stood Active
content:
The share so totalled is taken on the fee still standing and then scaled by how long the membership has stood active. Where the membership has stood active for the long member tenure months or more, the relief is taken at half as much again. Where it has stood active for the member tenure months or more but fewer than the long member tenure months, the relief is taken as the share gives. In any other case the relief is taken at half what the share gives.

The long member tenure months are 24. The member tenure months are 12.

## What is read

The months read are the months from the day the customer's Northbeam Circle Membership was activated to today. What is scaled is the relief the totalled share gives on the Northbeam Returns and Restocking fee still standing.

| Months the membership has stood active | The relief is taken at |
| --- | --- |
| 24 or more | half as much again as the share gives |
| 12 or more but fewer than 24 | what the share gives |
| fewer than 12 | half what the share gives |

## Both sides of each threshold, on hypothetical inputs

Take a fee still standing of 60.00 USD and a totalled share of 30 per cent, so that the share gives 18.00 USD.

*A membership that has stood active for 24 months.* Twenty-four is 24 or more, so the relief is 18.00 USD and half as much again, that is 27.00 USD.

*A membership that has stood active for 23 months.* That is fewer than 24 and 12 or more, so the relief is what the share gives, 18.00 USD.

*A membership that has stood active for exactly 12 months.* Twelve is 12 or more, so the relief is 18.00 USD.

*A membership that has stood active for 11 months.* That is fewer than 12, so the relief is half of 18.00 USD, that is 9.00 USD.
